name: 223. Structured output alongside function tools on pre-3 models (structured output with tools)
description: Gemini 2.5 and earlier reject responseMimeType "application/json" sent together with function declarations ("Function calling with a response mime type: 'application/json' is unsupported"). The chat converter already dropped the JSON response-format hint for those models; the Responses converter (convertParamsToGenerationConfigResponses) did not, so /v1/responses with a function tool plus text.format json_schema, and a bare-model /genai generateContent with functionDeclarations plus responseMimeType (which crosses the same neutral Responses path), came back as a 400. These cases pin a 200 on the gemini and vertex hosts, non-streaming and streaming, and on the /genai ingress. Each is red before the fix (Google 400) and green after.

item.name: 223.1 gemini/gemini-2.5-flash /v1/responses function tool with text.format json_schema returns 200 (structured output with tools)

exec: pm.test('no mime-type-with-tools rejection', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text(), 'Google rejected JSON mode next to function tools: ' + pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/response mime type/i); });
pm.test('gemini: the response carries output', function () { pm.expect(j.output, pm.response.text()).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });

item.name: 223.2 vertex/gemini-2.5-flash /v1/responses function tool with text.format json_schema returns 200 (structured output with tools)

exec: pm.test('no mime-type-with-tools rejection', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text(), 'Google rejected JSON mode next to function tools: ' + pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/response mime type/i); });
pm.test('vertex: the response carries output', function () { pm.expect(j.output, pm.response.text()).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });

item.name: 223.3 gemini/gemini-2.5-flash /v1/responses streaming function tool with text.format json_schema completes (structured output with tools)

exec: pm.test('no mime-type-with-tools rejection', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text(), 'Google rejected JSON mode next to function tools: ' + pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/response mime type/i); });
pm.test('gemini: the stream reached response.completed', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text(), 'no response.completed event: ' + pm.response.text()).to.include('response.completed'); });

item.name: 223.4 gemini-2.5-flash /genai generateContent functionDeclarations with responseMimeType json returns 200 (structured output with tools)

exec: pm.test('no mime-type-with-tools rejection', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text(), 'Google rejected JSON mode next to function tools: ' + pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/response mime type/i); });
